author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Hey, Goldie here!

So, I was wondering if we could make a sub-forum for ideas. It will go right under the "Server Feedback" and the rules in the post Funky (or Ivy, now) will be changed accordingly. I know the "Server Feedback" pretty much is for ideas, but I see lots of other topics that don't suggest any additions, only modifications to make the server/website better. I love to be creative and help support people, so an idea sub-forum will be perfect for me to hang around and help, while not having to sort through all the other posts. I would really like to see just a giant sub-forum swarming with creativity and originality, and ideas that will add things to improve the fun of the server/website, not removing features or changing them. I would be all about it. What do you think about this?
